build_gtn_package: build the gtn python package with cmake extensions using pip install from source
build_cmake_extension: build a CMakeExtension for gtn._graph by running python setup.py build_ext
check_cmake_version: check that cmake version 3.5.1 or higher is installed before building gtn
load_readme_description: load the README.md file content to use as the long description for the gtn package
configure_gtn_build: configure the gtn build with python bindings enabled and examples benchmarks and tests disabled
